data.body_html:
The F1 Grand Prix 2038 weekend in Marbella is set to be one of the most glamorous events on the Costa del Sol calendar. Whether you want to watch the race from the water, party at a beach club, or simply enjoy the buzz of Puerto Banús, a Marbella yacht charter F1 Grand Prix 2038 weekend offers the ultimate VIP experience. With our fleet of 15+ boats departing from Puerto Banús, you can secure your private vessel for the weekend and enjoy the action in style.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for the F1 Weekend?

Marbella transforms during the F1 weekend. The marina fills with supercars, celebrities, and high-end events. A private yacht gives you a floating base to escape the crowds, anchor near the race circuit, or cruise along the coast to spots like Cabopino or Estepona. You control the itinerary, the music, and the guest list. Plus, with a licensed skipper on board, you can relax and enjoy the day without worrying about parking or transport.

Our Fleet for the F1 Grand Prix 2038 Weekend

We offer a range of boats to suit different group sizes and budgets. All depart from Puerto Banús, the epicentre of Marbella's luxury scene.

Pricing and Inclusions

All our charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), prices start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 (Tier B) requires a minimum 4-hour booking at €4,719 and includes a free jet ski. All other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Best Spots to Watch the F1 Race from Your Yacht

While the official circuit is inland, many guests anchor near the coast and watch the race on a tablet or phone via live stream. Alternatively, you can moor at a beach club like Nikki Beach or Ocean Club, which often host F1 viewing parties. For a quieter experience, head to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, where you can swim and relax between sessions.

How to Book for the F1 Weekend

Demand for yacht charters during the F1 Grand Prix 2038 weekend is extremely high. We recommend booking at least 2–3 months in advance. Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability and secure your preferred boat. A deposit is required to confirm the booking, with the balance due 7 days before departure.

What to Expect on the Day

Your charter begins at Puerto Banús, where you'll meet your skipper. After a safety briefing, you'll cruise along the Marbella coastline, past the Golden Mile and La Concha mountain. You can anchor for swimming, visit a beach club, or simply enjoy the sun deck. The skipper will tailor the route to your preferences. All drinks and snacks are provided, but you're welcome to bring your own food.
